description: Flat, alias-resolved UIDS token inventory, WITHOUT provenance — the agent-facing copy. Same tokens and values as catalog/tokens.json with `note` and `source` dropped (~55% smaller). Read this one when generating; read tokens.json when you need to know WHY a token holds its value. Derived from tokens/ — do not edit. Root font size 16px. Component-tier breakpoints: mobile / md (>=980px) / page (>=1350px). Semantic *-mobile twins are the 600px clamp endpoints (Figma Semantic collection mode "small (600)").
